description.en: Original slab handheld family with sourced presets, display and control seats, media, battery bay and attachment interfaces.
description.es: Familia portátil plana original con presets documentados, pantalla, controles, medios, batería e interfaces.

description.en: Shared display/control tools and handheld body components, inlined at build.
description.es: Herramientas compartidas de pantalla, controles y cuerpo, integradas al generar.

message.en: Depth must leave room for two walls.
message.es: El fondo debe admitir dos paredes.

constraints.expression: screen_width < body_width - wall * 2 && screen_height < body_height - wall * 2

message.es: La pantalla debe caber en el cuerpo.

message.en: Battery door must fit the rear.
message.es: La tapa debe caber en la parte trasera.

message.en: Cylindrical cells require a larger body and room for the stack.
message.es: Las pilas cilíndricas requieren un cuerpo mayor y espacio para la pila.
